-- Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2c-E01: a registration no source token
-- spells. `@[command_elab ...]` attaches a command elaborator; `command_elab` is
-- an identifier, not a keyword, so rule 1's token half does not see it and only
-- the environment half (reading the elaborator extension) refuses it. The target
-- command is not invoked in this module, so it builds and perturbs nothing.
import Lean

open Lean Elab Command in
@[command_elab Lean.Parser.Command.check]
def rvV2cRegisteredElab : CommandElab := fun _ => pure ()
